about.dev.location.desc: We give users accurate and fast locating.
about.dev.location.title: Real-time locating
about.dev.p1: In this collection, the website is developed with love and dedication by a committed and enthusiastic team. From the very beginning until today, our goal has been to create a user-friendly and valuable learning environment.
about.dev.p2: We have always tried to provide the best user experience and make use of up-to-date technologies. With non-stop support and interaction, we stand by our users to resolve any question or ambiguity and ensure they learn in the best possible way.
about.dev.support.desc: Our team is always by your side and provides full support.
about.dev.support.title: Support anytime
about.dev.title: Built by passionate developers
about.feature.easyAccess.desc: By providing the right tools, we have made learning programming accessible to everyone.
about.feature.easyAccess.title: Easy access
about.feature.expertTeam.desc: Our team is made up of young, professional experts who stand by you with a love for teaching.
about.feature.expertTeam.title: Expert team
about.feature.projectBased.desc: Alongside theory, we make learning more enjoyable and deeper with practical, real-world projects.
about.feature.projectBased.title: Project-based learning
about.feature.support.desc: Our support team is always ready to help so you can move forward on your learning path with confidence.
about.feature.support.title: Continuous support
about.hero.desc: Here, we do our very best to introduce the world of programming to you in a simple and effective way. With practical and creative content, we take a step toward more advanced learning every day.
about.hero.title: An innovative approach to programming education
about.seo.description: About zanburak - a programming education platform with an innovative approach. Expert team, project-based learning, and continuous support.
about.seo.title: About zanburak
about.team.desc: We are an enthusiastic and creative team working together to provide comprehensive, high-quality education. Each member of our team is an expert in their field and, with strong motivation, shares their knowledge and experience with users. Together, and based on user feedback, we always strive to deliver up-to-date and practical content in an easy and understandable way.
about.team.hadi.description: Hadi is one of the most talented members of the team, answering users' questions and problems with great patience and care. He always tries to explain whatever is needed for better learning in simple language. With his rich experience and knowledge, Hadi is, alongside Milad, one of the main pillars of zanburak's support. Users feel more secure knowing they can always count on Hadi's help.
about.team.hadi.name: Hadi Zarehzadeh
about.team.leila.description: Leila is the graphic designer and front-end specialist of our team. With her creativity and great artistic taste, she beautifully designs the visual parts of the site and the courses. Leila always tries to make the designs and learning pages attractive enough that everyone enjoys paying attention to the lessons and learning. With her experience in graphics and UI design, Leila plays an important role in the beauty and usability of the site.
about.team.leila.name: Leila Biyabani
about.team.milad.description: Milad, the main founder of zanburak, is one of the most energetic and hardworking members of our team. With years of experience in programming, he passionately teaches everything he has learned to others. Milad believes that success in learning depends on persistence and practice, which is why he always tries to clearly explain even the small, practical details so everyone can progress more easily and quickly.
about.team.milad.name: Milad Mahaki
about.team.mohammad.description: With his expertise in quality management, Mohammad fully oversees the educational content to make sure every lesson is accurate and practical. Paying close attention to detail, he tries to keep the content always up to date and easy to understand. Mohammad is, in a way, the architect of the content, making sure everything published is truly high quality and properly covers users' needs.
about.team.mohammad.name: Mohammad Ghaedrahmati
about.team.title: Our team members
